header: One wide group portrait, with a name key
lead: The picture keeps its own proportions rather than being cropped to a ratio: a group portrait is composed around where the people are standing.
caption: The caption says what the picture is and when it was taken.
note: The note is the name key, left to right. It is set small and it wraps on a narrow screen — but it is never hidden, because it is the only place the people in the picture are named.
